turns.user_utterance: Using an ATM caused me to incur an additional fee. Why?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—fees from an ATM withdrawal can happen depending on the ATM operator and whether any foreign-currency or exchange charges apply. Was the withdrawal made in your card’s home currency, and do you see a fee described on the receipt or in your statement (e.g., “ATM fee” or “exchange”)?

turns.user_utterance: It was in my home currency, and the receipt just says “ATM fee.”
turns.assistant_response: Got it—if the receipt only says “ATM fee” and the withdrawal was in your home currency, the extra cost is typically an ATM operator fee (and sometimes a charge from the ATM network). If you tell me the country/ATM name and the exact fee amount, I can help confirm what it likely was and where it will show on your statement.
